title: The threat of Us
excerpt: Countdown Day 9: To be rebuked, marginalized, or excluded by Us is an even greater threat than to be attacked by the Other. (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 47) Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
body:
Countdown Day 9:

To be rebuked, marginalized, or excluded by Us is an even greater threat than to be attacked by the Other. (Brian D. McLaren, Why Did Jesus, Moses, the Buddha, and Mohammed Cross the Road? p. 47)

Learn more here: http://bit.ly/R8fzUI
